clips.title: The story
paras: At Saldean's Farm in central Westfall, Farmer Saldean keeps working the troubled fields beside his wife, Salma. While other farmers flee or give up, the veteran homesteader faces rogue harvest golems and growing banditry.

Farmer Saldean remembers when Westfall prospered, before those years crumbled away. Overgrown fields, rampaging mechanical harvest watchers, and predatory bandits now surround his farm, but he refuses to yield his land. Other homesteaders have abandoned their acres or turned to thievery. Saldean and his wife, Salma, stay and work to harvest what little grain they can. He asks wandering adventurers to destroy the rogue Harvest Watchers that have taken over his fields and his neighbors' fields, so he can clear the soil for planting.

Between Sentinel Hill and the northern bridge, Saldean's defense of his homestead helps keep civilian life going. He remains tied to the People's Militia despite the hard times, and sends able-bodied travelers to Gryan Stoutmantle once his immediate troubles are settled. Clearing the wild harvest reapers can only give his farm a temporary reprieve. The lawlessness strangling the countryside still has to be dealt with.
